meta.topStoryHeadline: Seven Black Creatives and Scholars Named 2026 MacArthur Fellows
meta.topStorySummary: The 2026 MacArthur class recognizes artists, writers, a jazz musician, a choreographer, and an economist among seven Black fellows. Each receives an unrestricted $800,000 fellowship over five years.
executiveSummary: The 2026 MacArthur Fellows include seven Black creatives and scholars, with recognition spanning jazz, dance, visual art, fiction, and economics. Nyancho NwaNri receives the Flickr × Black Women Photographers grant.

Museum labor negotiations have split: Whitney workers set an October 5 strike date, while Brooklyn Museum and American Folk Art Museum unions reach tentative agreements. Lawmakers introduce a bill to protect the Kennedy Center from demolition after an expedited Senate effort is blocked.

Kyle Abraham’s renamed company pairs a new identity with year-round dancer pay and royalties. Jocelyn Bioh’s School Girls opens on Broadway, Shuffle Along’s reunion will reach PBS in 2027, and a new exhibition examines Edmonia Lewis’s Montana connections.
